product_launches.description: AI Prospector is an AI-powered solution that automates account research, list building, and provides sales teams with insights for effective outreach.

overview_description.description: Nooks is an applied AI lab that powers modern sales organizations. Our platform automates sales busywork so reps can focus on the human side of selling and generate more qualified pipeline from outbound. Sellers access a single platform for prospecting, coaching, and calling. The platform learns through AI-powered feedback loops, helping teams to be more targeted and effective in their outbound. Thousands of sales teams at companies like Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Deel, and Udemy rely on the Nooks platform.

product.name: Nooks AI Prospector
product.description: An AI prospecting tool that uses buying signals and account research to prioritize targets, build prospect lists, enrich contact data, and draft personalized outreach emails.

product.name: Nooks AI Dialer
product.description: An AI-powered sales dialer that automates calling workflows, validates phone numbers, supports power and parallel dialing, and helps teams increase live conversations and meeting conversion.

product.name: Nooks AI Coach
product.description: An AI sales coaching product that records and analyzes calls, scores rep performance, summarizes conversations, identifies best practices, and provides roleplay training bots for rep development.
